title: Fleet Vehicle Tracking Log
subtitle: Fleet Vehicle Service: preserves changes and next triggers.
description: Fleet Vehicle Tracking Log covers fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision. The fleet maintenance coordinator records Fleet Vehicle Service events, owners, exceptions, and next triggers. Fleet Vehicle Tracking Log keeps Fleet Vehicle Service exceptions visible until the fleet maintenance coordinator handoff.
use_case: Use Fleet Vehicle Tracking Log at fleet yard, service facility, operating route, and vehicle assignment point. Document fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision identity before Fleet Vehicle Service begins. Compare fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision findings with stated Fleet Vehicle Service criteria; route unresolved Fleet Vehicle Service issues to qualified fleet maintenance reviewer. For Fleet Vehicle Tracking Log, confirm requirements for Fleet Vehicle Service. Ask qualified fleet maintenance reviewer to review Fleet Vehicle Service conditions beyond the fleet maintenance coordinator's role.

sections.title: Tracking period and subject identity
sections.guidance: For Fleet Vehicle Service, identify responsible parties, fleet yard, service facility, operating route, and vehicle assignment point, and the linked fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision source.

fields.label: Fleet unit, work order, and department
VIN, plate, mileage, engine hours, and assignment
Driver report, interval, prior defect, and campaign reference

sections.title: Tracking review and variance evidence
sections.guidance: Capture Fleet Vehicle Service facts for fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision; include result, limit, source, and next control.

blocks.label: Fleet Vehicle Service tracked controls
items: Parts, labor, downtime, and vendor status
Open campaign, recall, or recurring defect

sections.title: Tracking exception, status, and next update
sections.guidance: For Fleet Vehicle Service, preserve each open variance with its current state, accountable owner, and next dated update. Fleet Maintenance Coordinator performs period review.

blocks.label: Status exceptions, overdue actions, and retained evidence
items: Safety defect or overdue critical service
Repair exceeds authority or downtime commitment
blocks.guidance: Pause Fleet Vehicle Service when safety, maintenance, repeat-defect, authorization, or return-to-service concern remains unresolved. Retain the available Fleet Vehicle Service proof and route unresolved fleet unit, driver report, preventive-maintenance interval, defect, downtime, repair, and return-to-service decision scope to fleet maintenance coordinator.
